production.title: Developer quickstart - Exa
production.bodyText:
​
1. Get an API key
1

Visit the Exa Dashboard

Get your Exa API key
Create a key in the dashboard. New accounts start with free credits.
2

Set the key as an environment variable

macOS/Linux
Windows
export EXA_API_KEY="your-api-key"

​
2. Choose how you’ll use Exa
Exa fits into your application two ways: call the APIs from your own code, or connect an agent you already use.
Call the APIs
Use Search, Contents, and Exa Agent from your own code. Install an SDK below and make your first request.
Install an SDK
Connect your agent
Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or Cursor to Exa’s search and research tools. No API key is required.
Set up Exa MCP
Building with the APIs? Pick where to start:
Start with	Use it for
Search	Finding relevant web pages & returning synthesized content in under 2s
Deep Search	Higher-quality search where an LLM iteratively finds better results
Agent	Long-running asynchronous research, list building, enrichment, or reports
Contents	Extracting page content when you already have the URL(s)
​
3. Install an SDK
Python
JavaScript
pip install exa-py

​
4. Make your first request
Python
JavaScript
cURL
from exa_py import Exa

exa = Exa()

results = exa.search(
    "best blog posts about vector databases",
    contents={"highlights": True},
)

for result in results.results:
    print(result.title, result.url)

​
Next steps
Search API
Find relevant pages and return clean content or structured outputs.
Read guide
Agent API
Build long-running research, list-building, and enrichment workflows.
Read guide
Contents API
Extract clean content from pages you already know.
Read guide
Exa MCP
Connect any MCP client to Exa’s web search, page fetching, and Exa Agent tools.
Read guide
